Careers
Come build with us
Our Mission
Our team of engineers, AI researchers, and manufacturing experts are redefining what it means to integrate advanced technical solutions into the modern workforce. We’re not just the best in category, we created the category. Find out how you can help us stay in front.
Our Values
1
Take ownership.
Proactively identify opportunities, take initiative on solutions, and follow through on commitments. Learn from setbacks, iterate quickly, and empower others to execute with clear expectations and authority.
2
Build trust through collaboration.
Actively listen to diverse perspectives, honor commitments to teammates and customers, and take responsibility for collective success. Build alignment around shared goals while fostering inclusive collaboration.
3
Create value through adaptability.
Make resource-smart decisions focused on outcomes, maintain sustainable performance through work-life balance, and adapt effectively to changing priorities while planning strategically for the future.
Our Offices
Salem, OR
Where it all started and where we're still inventing what comes next. From our roots in a research lab at Oregon State University to becoming the driving force behind our manufacturing, this is the beating heart of Agility.
44.914928° N, -122.967323° W
Pittsburgh, PA
Where we peer around the next corner. As proud members of the Pittsburgh Robotics Network, our team here focuses on engineering testing, validation, and skills development, turning new ideas into capabilities you can count on.
40.473244° N, -79.963699° W
Fremont, CA
Where the AI revolution is happening. World-class talent, right on our doorstep, shaping what Digit will become and demonstrating to the San Francisco Bay Area and all of Silicon Valley everything it can do.
37.551398° N, -122.064345° W
Company
The future of labor starts here
We do more than build demos. We build robots that ship, deploy, and get to work. Safety, reliability, and real-world impact come first. But we're not stopping at what Digit can do today. We're working toward a future where this technology helps wherever it's needed.
